title: The Third Cipher
author: O. M. Whitlock
blurb: Edmund Eriksen, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
